QUOTE: "It then calls `client.createPost` again. On success it writes the server post and updates the last-post time for the channel... On failure, the same error handling applies: the three "removal" errors delete the post, and everything else sets `failed: true` again."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retryFailedPost makes one new createPost call and on failure marks the post failed again or deletes it for the three errors; it names no loop in the retry itself.
